name: Consecrated Triprism
description: Open with the court salute, the point low and the free hand high, covering two lines at once.

name: Majestic Rodtip
description: Prick twice in matched beats, first at the forearm and then at the shoulder above it.

name: Vigor Needlerod
description: Withdraw with a gliding step that keeps the shoulders level and the point on the opponent.

name: Reedseal
description: Cross the blade over the opposing weapon in a short beat that knocks the tip off line.

name: Ruling Spikeguard
description: Thrust through the opponent's cuff to pin it against his own wrist.

name: Pulsardarn
description: Cut inside the opponent's guard on a diagonal step and stab as the blades part.

name: Slimshaft Edict
description: Enter with two stabs a heartbeat apart, the second driven by qi through the hole the first opened.

name: Subjugating Hairpoint
description: Stab a nerve junction in the shoulder and seal it with qi so the arm hangs numb for a time.

name: Thunderclap Tinyquill
description: Spring skyward and fall in a flash of speed, the stiletto arriving before the shadow does.

name: Pulsarpin
description: The court's school stroke: two matched stabs on one point, the qi charge set by the student's own reserve.

name: Steelreed
description: Stand on the balls of the feet like a walker on a river bank, ready to step either way.

name: Fearless Boltpoint
description: Prick the opponent's two wrists in one flowing pair, as two channels flow from one bend.

name: Vigor Darn
description: Step aside in a short ripple of movement, never travelling more than a forearm's length.

name: Venom Pin
description: Tap the opponent's knuckles with a short jab, like a pebble disturbing the surface of a stream.

name: Squallrodtip
description: Curve the blade round an incoming cut in a bend that sweeps it wide of the body.

name: Darntriumph
description: Send qi down both arms and thrust, the two currents meeting in the point.

name: Seam Pledge
description: Stir the guard in clouded half-circles until the opponent loses which line the point will take.

name: Commanding Waxgrip
description: Draw the opponent's weapon sleeve along the stream of the blade and pin it at the hem.

name: Vacuumpin
description: Pierce the wrist where two tendons meet, qi flowing in from both tracks to deepen the stab.

name: Reedverdict
description: Run a rapid chain of pricks down the arm like water over rocks, forcing the foe to retreat.

name: Thread Heraldry
description: Surge through the guard like a river breaking into a delta, the point entering mid-flow.

name: Prism Darn
description: The school's closing stroke: two currents of qi converge in one stab, strength set by the student's reserve.

name: Prismrodtip
description: Hold two low guards, one hand at each hip, like two basins ready to catch a falling blow.

name: Prism Stitch
description: Prick at the rim of the opponent's guard where shield or sleeve meets the arm.

name: Pin Boon
description: Slide from one stance to the other keeping the knees bent and the head steady.

name: Vaunted Needlerod
description: Press the point in a little deeper with each breath, as a basin fills drop by drop.

name: Parityawl
description: Tip the blade like a pouring basin so the incoming strike spills off its flat to the side.

name: Rending Rodbase
description: Press both hands onto the opponent's weapon wrist, one with the blade flat and one with the palm.

name: Ruling Boltpoint
description: Show the same thrust on both low lines in turn like a basin's reflection, then strike high.

name: Prism Thread
description: Pierce two points of the opponent's body in a single quick breath, each charged from one basin of qi.

name: Gloomthread
description: Run pinprick after pinprick at the opponent's guard like water brimming over a rim, driving him back.

name: Pulsar Tinyquill
description: Let both basins of qi overflow into one stab that pierces layered guards in a single motion.

name: Stitchtroth
description: The school's sealing stroke: a stab into the weapon shoulder that locks the arm for a time set by qi spent.

name: Inviolate Spikeguard
description: Stand with the chest hollowed and the arms spread like a hawk gliding, blade held behind the hip.

name: Imperial Waxgrip
description: Jab downward and short like a hawk's beak at the exposed hand.

name: Deluge Probe
description: Step into the hollow behind a swinging weapon arm, out of reach of the swing.

name: Pall Rodtip
description: Sweep the free arm like a wing across the chest and turn the cut away over it.

name: Searing Slimshaft
description: Seize the opponent's sleeve with hooked fingers and pin the cloth with the point.

name: Paramount Probe
description: Glide in low and long over two steps and stab as the second foot lands.

name: Pulsar Rodbase
description: Dive into the hollow beneath the guard and pierce upward with qi concentrated in the point.

name: Pealthread
description: Loose a sharp cry with a pulse of qi to startle the foe and break his guard rhythm.

name: Silken Tinyquill
description: Vanish from the guard's sight and reappear above it, falling with the point leading.

name: Royal Stitch Banner
description: The school's own stroke: a hawk-glide entry ending in a hollow-bored stab whose force follows the qi given.

name: Bedrock Slimshaft
description: Perch high on the toes with the blade drawn back, still as a hawk before the dive.

name: Reminiscence Boltpoint
description: Fix the gaze on one point of the opponent while the rest of the body is read by feel.

name: Gallant Triprism
description: Jab down a steep line from the raised arm into the neck or shoulder.

name: Vigor Hairpoint
description: Rise onto the toes and step back as the stab ends, ready for the next dive.

name: Deluge Rodtip
description: Turn the guard arm like a wing so a cut skates off the sleeve toward the sky.

name: Unbending Darn
description: Catch the descending sword arm in the free hand and hold it against the chest with the point.

name: Radiance Waxgrip
description: Climb onto the toes during the opponent's guard and drop a thrust through the lowering arms.

name: Furious Thread
description: Spring back in a rising arc, letting a horizontal cut pass beneath the feet.

name: Radiance Stitch
description: Plunge from a height with qi packed in the point, piercing the shield rim and the arm behind.

name: Unbending Spikeguard
description: Dive as if to strike, rebound upward at the last moment, and drop again from the opposite side.

name: Thunderclap Probe
description: Streak down from the skyline in a flash and stab where the guard has not yet moved.

name: Unrivaled Triprism Crown
description: The school's stroke: a leaping plunge ending in a single stab, strength following the qi the student can spare.

name: Sundering Hairpoint
description: Stand with qi from the core divided into two tracks, one for each arm.

name: Darndecree
description: Jab along a line that runs straight from the core through the arm and out of the point.

name: Twilit Pin
description: Step with the core leading, so the hips arrive before the feet.

name: Solarawl
description: Switch the core's qi flow from the guard arm to the stab arm in the instant between parry and thrust.

name: Parity Rodbase
description: Receive a blow with a pulse of core qi that returns along the blade and throws the foe's weapon wide.

name: Thrallthread
description: Pin the opponent's forearm with the blade while the free hand draws the elbow across.

name: Lifegiving Tinyquill
description: Hold the breath and compress core qi to the arms before the thrust is released.

name: Prism Rodbase
description: Drive a thrust with core qi down one track and the weight of the hips behind it.

name: Season Pin
description: Burst out a volley of pinpricks from both hands in alternating tracks, driving the foe from his stance.

name: Seasonprobe
description: Flash across the guard distance with the core spinning, the stiletto entering before the stance can reset.

name: Sovereign Prism Triprism
description: The school's stroke: two tracks of core qi meeting at the point in one stab, scaled to the qi poured in.

name: Devout Needlerod
description: Stand on level ground with the blade low and forward and silently swear to hold the line.

name: Pulsar Boltpoint
description: Prick along the sworn line at the nearest hand, the wind carrying the point straight.

name: Squall Seam
description: Withdraw toward the wind so it slows the foe's pursuit rather than your retreat.

name: Parity Needlerod
description: Whip the blade across in a short gust and beat the opposing weapon off the sworn line.

name: Thrallseam
description: Pin the foe's cloak and draw it along the bearing so he stumbles after his own sleeve.

name: Vaunted Thread
description: Run flat out across the plateau and thrust at the end of the run with the wind behind.

name: Pallthread
description: Feint twice in gusts from opposite sides, then drive in along the line the foe left open.

name: Waxgrip Crown
description: Hold the sworn bearing through a guard's shift and pierce down it with qi gathered in the point.

name: Stitch Odyssey
description: Rush in on the crosswind's shoulder and stab as it unbalances the foe's stance.

name: Season Seam
description: Cross open ground in one burst of qi-driven speed and plant the point before the foe has turned.

name: Awlcrown
description: The school's sworn closing stroke: one held-bearing stab, its qi charge set by what the student can give.

name: Hairpoint Seal
description: Square the body to the foe with the feet braced for a sudden gust.

name: Splendid Spikeguard
description: Prick fast and flat at the knuckles, as a gust slaps a loose door.

name: Vigorreed
description: Slide to the side while the shoulders hold their original bearing on the target.

name: Devout Waxgrip
description: Break an incoming cut with a snapping parry timed to a gust, so the foe's arm is thrown off.

name: Millstone Rodtip
description: Pin a sleeve or strap and hold the bearing against the foe's attempts to turn away.

name: Paramount Seam
description: Rise with a sudden upward gust of the legs and drive the point at the ribs.

name: Radiance Pin
description: Ride a gust along the held bearing and pierce with qi driven from rear heel to point.

name: Dunepin
description: Retreat under the cover of a gust of qi-lifted dust, fading from the foe's sight.

name: Radiance Rodtip
description: Vanish along the bearing in a gust-quick burst and reappear at the foe's flank with the point set.

name: Majestic Steel Thread
description: The school's closing stroke: a bearing held through a gust and ended in a single stab, qi set by the student.

name: Steel Hairpoint
description: Stand in the open with the point resting on a mark at the foe's coat.

name: Benevolent Slimshaft
description: Choose a speck on the target and hold the gaze there through every shift of wind.

name: Pulsar Seam
description: Jab at the chosen speck with the arm rolled out for added reach.

name: Vigor Stitch
description: Step off the rear heel along open ground so the whole body travels with the point.

name: Venerable Slimshaft
description: Tip the blade into the wind so an incoming cut is pushed aside by the gust.

name: Crushing Probe
description: Pin a loose fold of the foe's clothing and hold the aim on the speck behind it.

name: Quenched Tinyquill
description: Run the length of the gap and pinprick the chosen speck at the end of the run.

name: Delugereed
description: Slip backward as a gust lifts, keeping the speck in view along the retreat.

name: Vacuumstitch
description: Fix the speck and loose a qi-charged thrust that lands on it through the full gale.

name: Statute Boltpoint
description: Whirl a storm of pricks around the foe in open ground until he cannot hold a line.

name: Pulsarprobe
description: Streak across open ground in one qi-driven flash and put the point exactly on the speck.

name: Majestic Radiance Triprism
description: The school's closing stroke: a long run and a single speck-fixed stab, force set by the qi spent.

name: Savage Spikeguard
description: Stand narrow and side-on like a thin gust through a gap, giving the foe little to hit.

name: Majestic Rodbase
description: Jab along the single sworn line with no wasted shift of the shoulders.

name: Darnsolace
description: Step along the foe's edge of reach without ever entering it fully.

name: Reedpledge
description: Turn the blade edge-on so only a narrow strip meets the blow and deflects it.

name: Sigil Rodbase
description: Pin the foe's sleeve to the nearest post or earth and hold the sworn line.

name: Steel Probe
description: Thrust narrow and straight so quickly that the wind seems to speak after the stab.

name: Commanding Needlerod
description: Waver the point just off the sworn line, then snap it back as the guard follows.

name: Seam Edict
description: Charge the point with qi and pierce along the narrow line before the guard re-forms.

name: Volition Triprism
description: Loose a steady gale of pricks on the sworn line, giving the foe no time to step off it.

name: Skyborne Pin
description: Flash down the sworn line at gale speed and finish with a single qi-bright stab.

name: Vacuumrodtip
description: The school's sworn stroke: one thrust on one line, its force following the qi the student gives.

name: Mighty Rodtip
description: Stand tall with the blade arm lifted into the wind and the weight on the front foot.

name: Pealawl
description: Raise the eyes to the foe's head and shoulders and read the stroke by what the shoulders do.

name: Dauntless Probe
description: Jab downward from a raised arm at the neck or collarbone.

name: Pealrodtip
description: Ride a rising draft with the blade flat and lift an incoming cut off its line.

name: Thrall Tinyquill
description: Pin the foe's upper arm to his side from above and hold the bearing against his twist.

name: Sovereign Stitch
description: Fall onto the foe with the wind at your back and the point leading the body.

name: Darn Verdict
description: Charge the falling stab with qi so the point passes a raised guard and bites the arm behind.

name: Deluge Slimshaft
description: Climb back up the draft after the stab and fall again from a changed angle.

name: Seasonrodtip
description: Drop from a leap in a blur of speed, the point arriving at the throat line before the leap ends.

name: Probebanner
description: The school's stroke: a fall from the high draft ending in one stab, strength set by the qi the student gives.

name: Titan Hairpoint
description: Stand open and relaxed with the core turning slowly, ready to send qi down either arm.

name: Spikeguard Gift
description: Watch the foe's hips and breathing and feel for the gale he is about to loose.

name: Stitchdecree
description: Jab with a sharp turn of the core so the stab arrives with the hips behind it.

name: Squall Thread
description: Step in any direction with the core staying level, never telegraphing the turn.

name: Pall Waxgrip
description: Turn the core into a parry so the blow glances off a small circle of the forearm.

name: Ruinous Darn
description: Pin the foe's weapon sleeve and hold the oath-sworn line against any pull.

name: Thunderclap Darn
description: Drive a thrust with a whip of the core, the point reaching its target before the shoulder moves.

name: Bedrock Spikeguard
description: Slide round the foe in a wide arc while the point holds its original bearing.

name: Pulsar Needlerod
description: Send the core's gale down the arm and pierce through the guard in one qi-charged stab.

name: Millstone Darn
description: Loose a storm of pricks from every side as the core turns, never letting the foe set his feet.

name: Ethereal Boltpoint
description: Flash across the gap on a burst of core qi and place the point at the throat.

name: Noble Vacuum Needlerod
description: The school's stroke: the whole core turning in one stab, its force set by the qi the student gives.
